pairs.target: xiǎo zhǎnkāi mén yǐqián , mǐlā bǎ qiáo tuī le qībiàn .
pairs.english: Before the exhibition opened, Mira pushed the bridge seven times.
pairs.hanzi: 小展开门以前，米拉把桥推了七遍。

pairs.target: dìbā biàn bèi tǎ wéi lánzhù le .
pairs.english: Tavi stopped the eighth attempt.
pairs.hanzi: 第八遍被塔维拦住了。

pairs.target: tā shuō zài tuīxiàqù , qiáo hái méi huài , zhuōzi dǐxià de rén jiùyào xiān chūlái mà .
pairs.english: He said that if she kept pushing, the person under the table would come out swearing before the bridge broke.
pairs.hanzi: 他说再推下去，桥还没坏，桌子底下的人就要先出来骂。

pairs.target: tāmen zhàn de chángzhuō yǒuxiē yáo , pà wò zhèng guì zài xiàmiàn sāi mùpiàn ,
pairs.english: Their long table wobbled a little; Pavo was kneeling underneath, wedging in wood pieces.
pairs.hanzi: 他们占的长桌有些摇，帕沃正跪在下面塞木片，

pairs.target: wényán tàn chū bànzhāng liǎn , shuō xiànzài yǐjīng xiǎng mà le .
pairs.english: Hearing this, he poked half his face out and said he already wanted to swear.
pairs.hanzi: 闻言探出半张脸，说现在已经想骂了。

pairs.target: chuāngwài liàng dé huǎngyǎn , dōngrì de tàiyáng zhàobúdào wūzi shēnchù .
pairs.english: Outside the windows the brightness dazzled, but winter sunlight could not reach deep into the room.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外亮得晃眼，冬日的太阳照不到屋子深处。

pairs.target: bǎi zhǎn de tīng yuánlái yònglái shài zhǐ , qiángshàng liú zhe yìpái xì mùdīng .
pairs.english: The exhibition hall had once been used to dry paper, and a row of slender wooden pegs remained on the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 摆展的厅原来用来晒纸，墙上留着一排细木钉。

pairs.target: jīntiān dīng shàng guà le dēngzhào , bùdài hé yìzhī bùzhī zuò shénme yòng de yuánlóng ,
pairs.english: Today they held lampshades, cloth bags, and a round cage of uncertain purpose.
pairs.hanzi: 今天钉上挂了灯罩、布袋和一只不知做什么用的圆笼，

pairs.target: lóngzi páng réng xiě zhe " zànshí bǎomì ", zhī duō le yíjù " bùxǔ wèishí ".
pairs.english: Beside the cage it still said “a secret for now,” with only one addition: “Do not feed.”
pairs.hanzi: 笼子旁仍写着“暂时保密”，只多了一句“不许喂食”。

pairs.target: mǐlā de qiáo bǎizài chuāng biān .
pairs.english: Mira's bridge stood beside the window.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉的桥摆在窗边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiě de shuōmíng pái zài qiánmiàn , yīwén bāng tā gǎiguò liǎnggè zì , méi tì tā zhòngchāo ,
pairs.english: Tavi's handwritten label stood in front. Iven had helped correct two characters but had not recopied it for him,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维写的说明牌在前面，伊文帮他改过两个字，没替他重抄，

pairs.target: yīncǐ mòwěi yìháng yuè xiě yuè xiǎo , xiàng zài gěi qiáo rànglù .
pairs.english: so the last line grew smaller and smaller, as though making room for the bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 因此末尾一行越写越小，像在给桥让路。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō kàndéjiàn jiù xíng , shēnshǒu bǎ páizi fúzhèng , yòu qù kānmén .
pairs.english: Mira said it was fine as long as people could read it, straightened the label, and looked toward the door again.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说看得见就行，伸手把牌子扶正，又去看门。

pairs.target: sū yǐ duān lái yìzhī zhuāng suìbù de hézi , názǒu zuówǎn jiègěi tāmen de jiǎndāo .
pairs.english: Suyi brought a box of cloth scraps and retrieved the scissors she had lent them last night.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡端来一只装碎布的盒子，拿走昨晚借给他们的剪刀。

pairs.target: tā zuò de dēngzhào yào zhuàndòng cái xiǎnchū lǐmiàn de shānyǐng , yǐjīng yǒurén wéizhe kàn .
pairs.english: Her lampshade had to turn to reveal the mountain shadows inside, and people were already gathering around it.
pairs.hanzi: 她做的灯罩要转动才显出里面的山影，已经有人围着看。

pairs.target: mǐlā wàng le yìyǎn , wèn zìjǐ de qiáo shìbushì tàiǎi , rén zài ménkǒu gēnběn kànbújiàn .
pairs.english: Mira glanced over and asked whether her bridge was too low for anyone at the door to see.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉望了一眼，问自己的桥是不是太矮，人在门口根本看不见。

alignment.english: too low for anyone at the door to see

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hái méi dá , yígè dīniánjí nǚhái yǐ zǒu dào zhuōqián , bǎ liǎngzhīshǒu fàng shàng le qiáodūn .
pairs.english: Before Tavi could answer, a girl from a lower class had reached the table and placed both hands on the piers.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维还没答，一个低年级女孩已走到桌前，把两只手放上了桥墩。

pairs.target: " tuī zhèlǐ ma ? "
pairs.english: “Push here?”
pairs.hanzi: “推这里吗？”

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu děng huídá , qīngqīng yì tuī , zhěnggè dǐbǎn wǎnghòu huá .
pairs.english: Without waiting for an answer, she pushed gently, and the entire base slid backward.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有等回答，轻轻一推，整个底板往后滑。

pairs.target: mǐlā de shǒu bǐ tǎ wéi gèng kuài , ànzhù bǎn jiǎo , chàdiǎn zhuàng fān shuōmíng pái .
pairs.english: Mira moved faster than Tavi, pinning a corner of the board and nearly knocking over the label.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉的手比塔维更快，按住板角，差点撞翻说明牌。

pairs.target: nǚhái lìkè sōngshǒu , shuō duìbùqǐ .
pairs.english: The girl immediately let go and apologized.
pairs.hanzi: 女孩立刻松手，说对不起。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō búshì tā de cuò , bǎ móxíng zhuǎn huíqù , zhǐzhe liáng tóu nà jié néng shēnchū de mùkuài , shuō shì zhè yíchù .
pairs.english: Mira said it wasn't her fault, turned the model back, and pointed to the extending block at the end of the beam: that was the place.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说不是她的错，把模型转回去，指着梁头那截能伸出的木块，说是这一处。

pairs.target: nǚhái wān xiàyāo , xiān kàn zì , zài kàn tā zhǐ de dìfāng .
pairs.english: The girl bent down, first looking at the words, then at the place Mira indicated.
pairs.hanzi: 女孩弯下腰，先看字，再看她指的地方。

pairs.target: " wǒ yǐwéi yào bǎ qiáo tuī cháng . "
pairs.english: “I thought you were supposed to push the bridge longer.”
pairs.hanzi: “我以为要把桥推长。”

pairs.target: " shì yào tuī cháng . "
pairs.english: “You are supposed to make it longer.”
pairs.hanzi: “是要推长。”

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén duì kàn le yíxià , dōu méiyǒu zài dòng .
pairs.english: They looked at each other, neither moving again.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人对看了一下，都没有再动。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái fāxiàn , páizi shàng nà jù tā zìjǐ dú dé hěn shùn dehuà , quèshí méi shuō gāi zhuā nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi realize that the sentence he himself read so easily truly did not say where to hold it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才发现，牌子上那句他自己读得很顺的话，确实没说该抓哪里。

pairs.target: tā nábǐ xiǎng tiān zì , mǐlā què bǎ bǐ dǎngzhù le .
pairs.english: He picked up a pen to add words, but Mira blocked it.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿笔想添字，米拉却把笔挡住了。

pairs.target: tā cóng sū yǐ hélǐ jiè le gēn hóngbùtiáo , rào zài huódòng de mùkuài shàng , dǎ le yígè hěnxiǎo de jié .
pairs.english: She borrowed a strip of red cloth from Suyi's box, wound it around the moving block, and tied a tiny knot.
pairs.hanzi: 她从苏苡盒里借了根红布条，绕在活动的木块上，打了一个很小的结。

pairs.target: ránhòu tā bǎshǒu shōuhuí , ràng nǚhái zìjǐ shì .
pairs.english: Then she withdrew her hands and let the girl try for herself.
pairs.hanzi: 然后她把手收回，让女孩自己试。

pairs.target: mùkuài huǎnhuǎn shēnchū , dǐxià de huázuò gēnzhe nuó .
pairs.english: The block extended slowly, and the sliding bearing beneath moved along with it.
pairs.hanzi: 木块缓缓伸出，底下的滑座跟着挪。

pairs.target: nǚhái yuánběn zhī dīng zhe hóngbù , hūrán dūnxiàqù , shuō xiàmiàn yě zài zǒu .
pairs.english: The girl had watched only the red cloth at first, but suddenly crouched and said the part below was moving too.
pairs.hanzi: 女孩原本只盯着红布，忽然蹲下去，说下面也在走。

pairs.target: mǐlā yě dūnxiàqù , gé zhe zhuō jiǎo gěi tā kàn lìngyìbiān ,
pairs.english: Mira crouched too, showing her the other side across the table corner.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉也蹲下去，隔着桌角给她看另一边，

pairs.target: jiǎnghuà bǐ gāngcái kuài le , liǎnshàng de jǐnbēng què yìdiǎndiǎn sōngkāi .
pairs.english: She spoke faster than before, while the tension in her face eased little by little.
pairs.hanzi: 讲话比刚才快了，脸上的紧绷却一点点松开。

pairs.target: pà wò zhōngyú cóng zhuōxià chūlái , étóu zhān zhe huī ,
pairs.english: Pavo finally emerged from under the table with dust on his forehead,
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃终于从桌下出来，额头沾着灰，

pairs.target: wèn xiànzài néng bunéng dāng yìhuí rén , ér búshì zhuōtuǐ .
pairs.english: asking whether he could be a person now instead of a table leg.
pairs.hanzi: 问现在能不能当一回人，而不是桌腿。

pairs.target: tā jǐ dào nǚhái pángbiān , gùyì bǎ yǎnjīng còu dé hěn jìn , wèn qiáo shàng zěnme méi zhù rén .
pairs.english: He squeezed beside the girl, deliberately peered close, and asked why nobody lived on the bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 他挤到女孩旁边，故意把眼睛凑得很近，问桥上怎么没住人。

pairs.target: " gěi nǐ liú de . " mǐlā shuō .
pairs.english: “Saved it for you,” Mira said.
pairs.hanzi: “给你留的。”米拉说。

pairs.target: " nà dé jiā wūdǐng . "
pairs.english: “Then it needs a roof.”
pairs.hanzi: “那得加屋顶。”

pairs.target: nǚhái xiào le , bǎ hóngbù qīngqīng tuīhuíqù , yòu lā chūlái yíbiàn .
pairs.english: The girl laughed, gently pushed the red cloth back, and pulled it out again.
pairs.hanzi: 女孩笑了，把红布轻轻推回去，又拉出来一遍。

pairs.target: zhè yìhuí méiyǒu rén tì tā fú .
pairs.english: This time nobody steadied it for her.
pairs.hanzi: 这一回没有人替她扶。

pairs.target: tīnglǐ jiànjiàn jǐ qǐlái .
pairs.english: The hall gradually filled.
pairs.hanzi: 厅里渐渐挤起来。

pairs.target: yīwén dài le liǎnggè héchàngduì de rén láikàn , kàn wán biàn dào bié zhuō qù , méiyǒu liúxià tì tāmen jièshào .
pairs.english: Iven brought two choir members to look, then went on to another table without staying to explain things for them.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文带了两个合唱队的人来看，看完便到别桌去，没有留下替他们介绍。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài mǐlā shēnhòu , tīng tā xiàng yì bō yòu yì bō rén jiěshì .
pairs.english: Tavi stood behind Mira, listening as she explained to group after group.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在米拉身后，听她向一拨又一拨人解释。

pairs.target: yǒu yìhuí tā bǎ " shítái " shuō chéng " shítáng ", zìjǐ hái méi fājué ,
pairs.english: Once she said “dining hall” instead of “stone platform” without noticing.
pairs.hanzi: 有一回她把“石台”说成“食堂”，自己还没发觉，

pairs.target: tā zài hòumiàn hāi le yìshēng , tā zhuǎntóu dèng tā , suíhòu yě xiào le .
pairs.english: He coughed behind her; she turned and glared at him, then laughed too.
pairs.hanzi: 他在后面咳了一声，她转头瞪他，随后也笑了。

pairs.target: yígè chuān huī duǎnyī de nánrén tíng dé jiǔ xiē , xiùkǒu yǒu hěn xì de báihuī .
pairs.english: A man in a short gray coat lingered longer, with fine white dust on his cuffs.
pairs.hanzi: 一个穿灰短衣的男人停得久些，袖口有很细的白灰。

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ zài xuégōng xiū táijiē , tīng wán biàn wèn , qiáo ruò cóng cèmiàn shòu le tuīlì , zhège huázuò huì buhuì pǎochūqù .
pairs.english: He said he repaired the academy's steps, then asked whether a sideways force on the bridge would push the sliding bearing out.
pairs.hanzi: 他说自己在学宫修台阶，听完便问，桥若从侧面受了推力，这个滑座会不会跑出去。

alignment.english: would push the sliding bearing out

pairs.target: mǐlā zhǐzhe xīn jiā de cè dǎng , shuō tā zài zhèlǐ lán zhe .
pairs.english: Mira pointed to the new side guide and said it stopped it here.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉指着新加的侧挡，说它在这里拦着。

pairs.target: nánrén yòng shǒu bǐ le bǐ liáng de gāodù , méi pèng móxíng ,
pairs.english: Without touching the model, the man indicated the beam's height with his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 男人用手比了比梁的高度，没碰模型，

pairs.target: shuō zhēnzhèng de qiáo shòulì gèng zá , fēng yě bù zǒng shùnzhe qiáo chuī , zhè liǎngpiàn báo biān kě bùnéng zhàoyàng bānshàngqù .
pairs.english: He said a real bridge faced more complicated forces; wind did not always blow along it, and these two thin sides could not simply be copied at full scale.
pairs.hanzi: 说真正的桥受力更杂，风也不总顺着桥吹，这两片薄边可不能照样搬上去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi mǐlā huì jí zhe biànjiě .
pairs.english: Tavi expected Mira to hurry to defend herself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为米拉会急着辩解。

pairs.target: tā què bǎ móxíng zhuǎnguò yìdiǎn , ràng nà rén kànqīng cè dǎng de gùdìng chù ,
pairs.english: Instead she turned the model a little so the man could see how the guide was fixed,
pairs.hanzi: 她却把模型转过一点，让那人看清侧挡的固定处，

pairs.target: wèn ruò bú zhào zhège zuò , tā jiàn guò shénmeyàng de .
pairs.english: and asked what other arrangements he had seen.
pairs.hanzi: 问若不照这个做，他见过什么样的。

pairs.target: nánrén shuō tā xiū de shì shíjiē , méi zhuāng guò dàqiáo zuò ;
pairs.english: The man said he repaired stone steps and had never fitted a large bridge bearing;
pairs.hanzi: 男人说他修的是石阶，没装过大桥座；

pairs.target: yǒuxiē xiǎo lángqiáo kào héngxiàng lā jié , jùtǐ de dé zhǎo zuò guò de rén wèn .
pairs.english: some small covered bridges relied on transverse ties, but for details they should ask someone who had done the work.
pairs.hanzi: 有些小廊桥靠横向拉结，具体的得找做过的人问。

pairs.target: tā ná zìjǐ bù dǒng de dìfāng kāilegè wánxiào , mǐlā biàn bǎ běnzi fān dào kōngyè , huà xià tā bǐ guò de fāngxiàng .
pairs.english: He joked about his own ignorance, and Mira turned to a blank page and drew the direction he had indicated.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿自己不懂的地方开了个玩笑，米拉便把本子翻到空页，画下他比过的方向。

pairs.target: děng tā zǒu le , tǎ wéi wèn tā shìbushì yòu yào chāi .
pairs.english: After he left, Tavi asked whether she was going to dismantle it again.
pairs.hanzi: 等他走了，塔维问她是不是又要拆。

pairs.target: mǐlā yòng zhǐjié qiāo le qiāo mùbǎn , shuō xiān bù chāi , tā hái xiǎng duō ràng jǐgè rén shì .
pairs.english: Mira tapped the board with her knuckles and said not yet; she wanted a few more people to try.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉用指节敲了敲木板，说先不拆，她还想多让几个人试。

pairs.target: zhìyú cèmiàn , tā xiǎng zhǎo tú kànkàn ,
pairs.english: As for the sideways force, she wanted to find drawings to look at;
pairs.hanzi: 至于侧面，她想找图看看，

pairs.target: búshì jīntiān bèi wèn zhù jiù dé mǎshàng bǔ chū yízuò zhēnde qiáo .
pairs.english: being stumped today did not mean she had to produce a real bridge immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 不是今天被问住就得马上补出一座真的桥。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhān huī de pà wò huà zài tā nà zhāng cǎotú jiǎo shàng , huà dé hěnxiǎo , tóushàng dǐng zhe yípiàn wūdǐng .
pairs.english: Tavi drew dusty Pavo in a corner of her sketch, very small, with a roof balanced on his head.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把沾灰的帕沃画在她那张草图角上，画得很小，头上顶着一片屋顶。

pairs.target: mǐlā kànjiàn , xiào dé wān xiàyāo , jiào tā bǎ zhè rén cóng tā de qiáo shàng bānzǒu .
pairs.english: Seeing it, Mira doubled over laughing and told him to remove this person from her bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看见，笑得弯下腰，叫他把这人从她的桥上搬走。

pairs.target: wǔhòu rén shǎo le xiē , tāmen lúnliú qù chī dōngxī .
pairs.english: In the afternoon the crowd thinned, and they took turns going for food.
pairs.hanzi: 午后人少了些，他们轮流去吃东西。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huílái shí , zhuōqián zhàn zhe yígè jì zhǎnpǐn de gāoniánjí xuéshēng , zhèng wèn móxíng shì shuí zuò de .
pairs.english: When Tavi returned, an older student recording the exhibits stood at the table, asking who had made the model.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回来时，桌前站着一个记展品的高年级学生，正问模型是谁做的。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō shì zìjǐ xiǎng de , cáo shì tǎ wéi zhé de , zì yě shì tā xiě de , yīwén xiào guò ,
pairs.english: Mira said the idea was hers; Tavi had bent the channel and written the label, and Iven had checked it.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说是自己想的，槽是塔维折的，字也是他写的，伊文校过，

pairs.target: zhuōzi xiàmiàn nà jǐpiàn mùtou dé suàn pà wò de .
pairs.english: The pieces of wood under the table should be credited to Pavo.
pairs.hanzi: 桌子下面那几片木头得算帕沃的。

pairs.target: nà xuéshēng dītóu xiě , tīngdào zuìhòu yíxiàng , táitóu quèrèn le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: The student wrote with his head down, then looked up to confirm the last item.
pairs.hanzi: 那学生低头写，听到最后一项，抬头确认了一遍。

pairs.target: mǐlā hěn rènzhēn dì diǎntóu . pà wò bú zài , tǎ wéihé mǐlā què tóngshí xiàoleqǐlái .
pairs.english: Mira nodded very seriously. Pavo wasn't there, but Tavi and Mira laughed at the same time.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉很认真地点头。帕沃不在，塔维和米拉却同时笑了起来。

pairs.target: kuài shōu zhǎn shí , zuìzǎo lái de nǚhái yòu dài le yígè péngyǒu guòlái .
pairs.english: Near closing time, the first girl returned with a friend.
pairs.hanzi: 快收展时，最早来的女孩又带了一个朋友过来。

pairs.target: zhècì bù děng mǐlā kāikǒu , tā yǐjīng zhǐzhe hóngbù jiěshì ,
pairs.english: This time, before Mira could speak, she was already pointing at the red cloth and explaining,
pairs.hanzi: 这次不等米拉开口，她已经指着红布解释，

pairs.target: shǒuzhǐ cóng qiáomiàn yí dào xiàmiàn , dài zhe péngyǒu kàn nà yìdiǎn xiǎoxiǎode nuódòng .
pairs.english: her finger moving from the bridge deck to the underside, showing her friend that tiny movement.
pairs.hanzi: 手指从桥面移到下面，带着朋友看那一点小小的挪动。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhàn zài pángbiān , méiyǒu chāhuà .
pairs.english: Mira stood beside them without interrupting.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉站在旁边，没有插话。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn tā qiāoqiāo bǎ xiěgěi fùqīn de nà zhāng cǎogǎo fānchūlái ,
pairs.english: Tavi saw her quietly bring out the draft of her letter to her father,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见她悄悄把写给父亲的那张草稿翻出来，

pairs.target: zài " wǒmen zuò le yízuò qiáo " shàng huà le yídào , gǎichéng " wǒ xiǎng le yígè bànfǎ ".
pairs.english: cross out “We made a bridge,” and replace it with “I thought of a way.”
pairs.hanzi: 在“我们做了一座桥”上划了一道，改成“我想了一个办法”。

pairs.target: tā jiēzhe wǎng xià xiě , chuāngshàng de guāng mànmàn yí dào zhǐbiān .
pairs.english: She kept writing as the light from the window slowly moved to the edge of the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 她接着往下写，窗上的光慢慢移到纸边。
